role.zh: 第四范式 4Paradigm 创始人、董事长兼 CEO

why.en: A transfer-learning researcher by training who turned machine learning into enterprise decision infrastructure — the most committed practitioner of the AI-to-B route in China.
why.zh: 迁移学习研究者出身，把机器学习平台化为企业决策基础设施，是中国 AI to B 路线最坚定的实践者。

title.en: AI Agent and collaborative operation: enterprise intelligent transformation
title.zh: AI Agent 与协同运营：企业智能化转型

title.en: Vol34 中美AI对决：谁更接近AGI？丨对话戴文渊X transformer周
title.zh: Vol34 中美AI对决：谁更接近AGI？丨对话戴文渊X transformer周

note.en: Dai appears as a guest to debate whether China or the US is closer to AGI, laying out 4Paradigm's read on the race.
note.zh: 戴文渊作为嘉宾参与对谈，讨论中美两国谁更接近AGI，阐述第四范式对这场竞赛的判断。

title.en: Optimizing in-memory database engine for AI-powered on-line decision augmentation using persistent memory
title.zh: Optimizing in-memory database engine for AI-powered on-line decision augmentation using persistent memory

note.en: Describes an in-memory database engine using persistent memory for real-time AI-driven decisioning, matching 4Paradigm's enterprise-AI infrastructure work.
note.zh: 介绍一种利用持久内存的内存数据库引擎,用于AI驱动的实时决策增强,与第四范式的企业级AI基础设施工作相符。

title.en: Network On Network for Tabular Data Classification in Real-world Applications
title.zh: Network On Network for Tabular Data Classification in Real-world Applications

note.en: Proposes a neural architecture for tabular-data classification aimed at real-world industrial applications, in line with his ML research at 4Paradigm.
note.zh: 提出一种面向表格数据分类及工业应用的神经网络架构,与他在第四范式的机器学习研究方向一致。

title.en: AutoSF: Searching Scoring Functions for Knowledge Graph Embedding
title.zh: AutoSF: Searching Scoring Functions for Knowledge Graph Embedding

note.en: Proposes an automated search method for scoring functions used in knowledge-graph embedding models.
note.zh: 提出一种自动搜索知识图谱嵌入模型评分函数的方法。

note.en: Chapter from the "Transfer Learning" textbook he co-authored with Qiang Yang, surveying real-world applications of the field.
note.zh: 他与杨强合著的《迁移学习》教科书章节,综述了迁移学习的实际应用。

note.en: Foundational chapter from the same "Transfer Learning" textbook laying out the theoretical basis of the field.
note.zh: 同一本《迁移学习》教科书中的基础理论章节。

note.en: Textbook chapter applying transfer-learning techniques to recommender systems.
note.zh: 教科书章节,探讨迁移学习技术在推荐系统中的应用。

note.en: Textbook chapter applying transfer learning to dialogue systems.
note.zh: 教科书章节,探讨迁移学习在对话系统中的应用。

note.en: Textbook chapter applying transfer learning to human activity recognition.
note.zh: 教科书章节,探讨迁移学习在人体行为识别中的应用。

note.en: Textbook chapter covering privacy-preserving approaches to transfer learning.
note.zh: 教科书章节,探讨隐私保护下的迁移学习方法。

title.en: AutoCross: Automatic Feature Crossing for Tabular Data in Real-World Applications
title.zh: AutoCross: Automatic Feature Crossing for Tabular Data in Real-World Applications

note.en: AutoCross, 4Paradigm's automatic feature-crossing method for tabular business data — the AutoML line that underpins the company's enterprise product.
note.zh: AutoCross 是第四范式面向企业表格数据的自动特征交叉方法，正是支撑其商业产品的 AutoML 技术路线。

title.en: AutoML @ NeurIPS 2018 challenge: Design and Results
title.zh: AutoML @ NeurIPS 2018 challenge: Design and Results

note.en: The design and results report for the NeurIPS 2018 AutoML challenge on lifelong learning with concept drift, which he co-organised.
note.zh: 他参与组织的 NeurIPS 2018 AutoML 挑战赛（终身学习与概念漂移方向）的赛制设计与结果报告。

title.en: Differential Private Stack Generalization with an Application to Diabetes Prediction
title.zh: Differential Private Stack Generalization with an Application to Diabetes Prediction

note.en: A 4Paradigm paper on stacked generalization under differential privacy, recovering predictive accuracy on a diabetes-prediction task after privacy noise is added.
note.zh: 第四范式的一篇论文，研究差分隐私下的堆叠泛化方法，在加入隐私噪声后仍能恢复糖尿病预测任务的准确率。

title.en: 范式智能拟A股上市：43岁戴文渊控股34%，曾是百度架构师
title.zh: 范式智能拟A股上市：43岁戴文渊控股34%，曾是百度架构师

body.en: 4Paradigm moved to list on China's A-share market, with Dai Wenyuan holding about 34% of the company.
body.zh: 范式智能（第四范式）启动A股上市，戴文渊持股约34%。

title.en: 范式CEO戴文渊：AI两极分化严重 绝大多数开发者不需要万卡集群
title.zh: 范式CEO戴文渊：AI两极分化严重 绝大多数开发者不需要万卡集群

body.en: Dai argued AI is polarizing sharply and that most developers don't need massive 10,000-GPU clusters, a stance on realistic enterprise AI infrastructure needs.
body.zh: 戴文渊表示AI两极分化严重，绝大多数开发者并不需要万卡级别的集群，这是他对企业AI基础设施实际需求的看法。
